summary: One open 3D swimming-track dataset exists (CC0 Dryad zip of magnetotactic-coccus tracks with double helical paths, 456 MB) and the BioImage Archive holds tracking videos of Chlamydomonas and schistosome miracidia, but none is confirmed to record body-axis rotation alongside path curvature for ciliates or flagellates, and no no-rotation control was found.
next_step: Inspect the Dryad zip's file listing in a browser and read the S-BIAD1298 and S-BIAD2286 file lists to see whether they are 2D videos or tracks; if body rotation is not recorded, the test needs new imaging or a published rotation-rate table.
obstacles_confirmed: Open 3D tracks found are for bacteria, not ciliates or flagellates.
Archive videos are of Chlamydomonas and miracidia; dimensionality and orientation data are not stated in the metadata.
No dataset with swimmers lacking rotation was found.
